text:
Alex G: Quick sync — launching the Benchmark + Webinar email on Thu 9AM PT. Need final copy, RSVP gating, and inbound routing rules. Can ppl confirm seg + send windows? :rocket:
Meera: On it. Which cohorts are primary? trials (30d), newsletter active, and benchmark downloaders?
Lia: Agree those. Suggest we treat benchmark downloaders as highest intent — invite + CTA to book a demo after RSVP.
Evan: APAC folks need a separate send window. If we send 9AM PT that's late evening APAC. Recommend a stagger: 9AM PT for NA/EU, 9AM SGT for APAC (same creative w/ localized times).
Paige: Subject test ideas: A) "See Redwood's latest inference benchmark + live demo" B) "How we cut 4x inference cost — webinar + benchmark". Also we should test emoji vs no-emoji.
Alex G: Love it. Meera — can you own RSVP gating? We want RSVP to capture company + role and route to sdr-benchmark if role=Product/ML or enterprise tier.
Meera: Yup. Doing RSVP via Typeform embed. We'll add hidden UTM params: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch, utm_source=email, cohort=trial|newsletter|download.
Lia: For routing, simplest is webhook on submit -> route rule: if tier in [enterprise, trial-enterprise] OR role matches /(PM|ML|Engineering)/ -> sdr-benchmark else sdr-inbound. Quick pseudo-rule: 
```
if (role =~ /(PM|ML|Engineer)/ || tier == "enterprise") {
  route_to = "sdr-benchmark"
} else {
  route_to = "sdr-inbound"
}
```
Evan: Ops question — will RSVP form create a lead in CRM with UTM and assign owner? Ops-bot: deploy scheduled for Wed 18:00 PT to wire form + webhook to CRM staging.
Paige: Suppression rules: exclude anyone who opened benchmark email in last 7 days or attended past 60d webinars. Also exclude unsubscribed.
Alex G: CTA flow: RSVP -> confirmation w/ calendar link + optional "book demo" button for enterprise prospects. Lia: we'll surface demo CTA only when form indicates enterprise/role match.
Meera: Copy for email hero (first pass): "New benchmark: real-world inference at scale. Join our webinar to see latency, cost breakdowns, and an ops walkthrough." Will drop full draft in #copy channel in 30m.
Paige: Can we get short one-liner for subject preview/ preheader? Suggest: "Benchmark insights + live demo — Thu, 9AM PT"
Evan: Confirming timezone segments and suppression windows. I'll push the segment exports to shared drive by EOD.
Alex G: Perfect — final checklist: Meera (RSVP wiring + form fields), Lia (routing rules + demo CTA logic), Paige (send cadence + suppressions), Evan (segments & exports), ops-bot (deploy webhook). Ping me when everything is green and we’ll do a 15m pre-send check Wed 3PM PT. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Reminder — webhook deploy job queued: release/marketing/forms -> staging (Wed 18:00 PT).
Meera: Noted, will validate form events in staging and simulate routing.
